entry.title: Neuromorphic In-Memory Computing for Edge Semiconductor Accelerators
entry.summary: We survey spiking neural network accelerators built on emerging non-volatile memory devices and discuss how machine learning compilers map convolutional workloads onto analog crossbar arrays. Results on a synthetic semiconductor process benchmark show energy reductions versus digital baselines.

entry.title: Deep Learning for Crop Disease Detection from Multispectral Drone Imagery
entry.summary: Precision agriculture pipelines increasingly rely on deep learning to detect early plant stress from multispectral UAV imagery. We present a compact CNN trained on open field datasets and evaluate transfer learning for low-data farms. The model targets edge deployment on farm gateways.

entry.title: Wide-Bandgap Sensor Front-Ends for Agritech Soil Monitoring
entry.summary: Silicon carbide and gallium nitride front-end electronics enable robust soil-moisture and nutrient sensing under harsh field conditions. We combine a compact ML calibrator with a GaN readout ASIC and report field trial results from irrigated plots.
